verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that conversation-flow settings govern how the agent handles interruptions during speech and turn-taking, and that turn-taking and interruption behavior is configurable. That establishes barge-in handling as a supported, tunable capability. However, the evidence only names the feature and does not describe what happens on an interruption. Missing for 10: documentation that speech playback stops on barge-in, details of how conversation context is updated after an interruption (e.g. truncating the unspoken response), how the turn is recovered, and independent or hands-on corroboration of interruption quality.
